message: My router restarts every few minutes. How can I fix this?
reference_answer: Check official 12V 2A power adapter, verify ventilation, and upgrade firmware to v2.4.1 or later.

message: How do I factory reset my router? I forgot the admin password.
reference_answer: Hold the physical Reset pinhole button continuously for 10 to 12 seconds until LEDs flash amber.
